title: Traversal Raises $120M at $1B Valuation for AI Reliability Software
summary:
The provider of AI-driven site reliability tools has secured fresh capital to expand its platform designed to automate the identification and repair of outages in live software environments. Traversal's system maps the dependencies between various services and simultaneously analyzes metrics and logs to pinpoint the root cause of system failures when they occur.

The startup is targeting a rise in production errors caused by the accelerated pace of code deployment through AI coding assistants, which often outstrips the capacity for human review. The company already provides its software to a client base that includes DigitalOcean, Nubank, and PepsiCo.

Coding agents are making it easier to ship more code. Someone still has to keep it running.

Traversal works on that side. It maps live services and their dependencies, and when something breaks, it checks several possible causes in parallel. What it learns about production also goes back to the coding agents.

So far most AI tooling has gone into writing code. Less of it has gone into what happens after deployment.
